value.rationale: The deterministic endpoint p=1 is singular: fixed-p long-time transport becomes diffusive but deterministic trajectories are four-cycles. The critical window n(1-p_n)=O(1) is the natural regime with order-one randomizations and yields a genuine three-law phase structure, an explicitly computable non-Gaussian propagator and a physically interpretable Poisson center. The exact mean-square profile quantifies the noncommutation of deterministic and long-time limits, and the Gaussian lambda->infinity result links it back to diffusive behavior.
